svg.text: Phase 2 · step 8f · PDFs: adding one, and the viewer (two options)
Adding: + Add's sheet gets Choose a PDF; the app draws the first page as its thumbnail; the tile shows its page count. Viewing: below.
Both · Adding a PDF: + Add → Choose a PDF; its tile is the first page, with its page count
Wide · a repair's task, and the Documents tab later (8h)
Uploading: the file goes as it is (up to 50 MB); the server checks it's a PDF and counts its pages (8d.1).
A PDF the server can't open (damaged, or locked with a password) is refused with a message.
A · Our own viewer, like the photo viewer: the pages one under another; zoom, page n of N, Download
Scroll for the next page; the page number follows. Pages draw as they come into view. Text can be selected and copied.
B · pdf.js's own full viewer, opened inside the app: thumbnails, search, print, zoom
pdf.js's own look (grey, its icons), in a frame; Back returns to the app.
− Its own look, not the app's;
its controls are small on a
− More of pdf.js to keep up to
Either way, pdf.js is bundled with the app (no CDN; works on the NAS without the internet) and is the same on web and desktop (#037).
